statement: Premium Samsung Electro-Mechanics high-capacitance MLCCs sourced through DigiKey are reaching around 40 weeks, or nearly ten months.
why: A ten-month wait at the premium end means spot buyers cannot close gaps in their bill of materials within any current build cycle.

impact.mechanism: Distributor lead times near forty weeks on top-specification passives push AI-server completion dates out and force redesign or downgrade to lower-specification parts.

evidence.excerpt: Premium products sourced via distributor DigiKey -- specifically Samsung Electro-Mechanics high-capacitance MLCCs -- are reaching 'around 40 weeks, or nearly 10 months'.

confidence.basis: Single secondary research article reporting one distributor's quoted lead time; not a supplier disclosure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 20.0 -> 40.0 (tol 1%); sources: TrendForce
